hints.title: Bounding Coordinates
hints.text: Find the minimum and maximum row indices, and minimum and maximum column indices, of all cells containing 1.

hints.title: Dimension Lengths
hints.text: The height of the enclosing rectangle is max_r - min_r + 1 and the width is max_c - min_c + 1.

hints.title: Area Calculation
hints.text: Multiply height by width to obtain the minimum bounding rectangle area.
